name: canopy
description: Manage software architecture, projects, milestones, teams, Jira sync, and Gantt scheduling from Claude — with review-first change proposals: stage updates from any source (Slack, email, meetings, Jira, GitHub, Drive) for the architect to review and commit in the canopy UI.
author: Canopy

api_base_url.title: Canopy API base URL
api_base_url.description: Base URL of the canopy backend, e.g. http://localhost:8000 (in production, your dashboard's origin).

api_token.title: Canopy agent token
api_token.description: Agent-scoped token minted from the canopy dashboard's Agent Setup page (or a JWT from POST /api/v1/auth/login).

dashboard_url.title: Canopy dashboard URL (optional)
dashboard_url.description: Base URL of the canopy web dashboard, used for review links (change proposals). In production this is usually the same origin as the API; for local dev use the Vite server, e.g. http://localhost:5173. Leave blank to fall back to the API base URL.

api_email.title: Canopy account email (optional)
api_email.description: Alternative to the token: canopy account email the MCP server logs in as (auto-refreshes the JWT). Leave blank when using a token.

api_password.title: Canopy account password (optional)
api_password.description: Password for the account email above (used to mint/refresh the JWT automatically). Leave blank when using a token.
